notes.title: “Psycho-Sleuth” Wins 3 Awards at Bahamut ACG Creative Contest!
notes.notes:
[h3]We’re thrilled to share that [b]Psycho-Sleuth[/b] has received three awards at the 2024 [b]Bahamut ACG Creative Contest[/b]:[/h3][p][/p][h3]🏆 [b]Silver Award[/b]
📈 [b]Market Potential Award[/b] [/h3][h3]🎖️ [b]SGArts Special Award[/b][/h3][p][/p][h3]This recognition is a huge encouragement for our small team. We've been dedicated to crafting a story that blends unique characters, psychological disorders, and classic detective elements—and it's incredibly rewarding to be acknowledged by industry veterans and expert judges.[/h3][h3]Thank you to all the players and supporters who’ve been with us on this journey.
We’ll keep polishing the game to deliver the best experience we can.[/h3][h1]
[b]Free Demo Coming: September 25, 2025[/b][/h1][h1]
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3432860/PsychoSleuth/?l=tchinese"][/dynamiclink]💡 [b]Add to your wishlist![/b][/h1][p]You'll be notified the moment our free demo and future updates go live.[/p][p]Don't miss the beginning of this psychological mystery journey![/p]

notes.title: Welcome to the world of PSYCHO-SLEUTH!
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621464/806bcc17c21b7c8ed041ea408e5faa5fb030b438.png"][/img][/p][p]We are an indie game team from Taiwan, developing this mystery adventure game filled with supernatural abilities, intricate puzzles, and psychological conflicts.
[i]PSYCHO-SLEUTH[/i] is a deadly investigation centered around "Afflicted Powers"—13 characters with unique mental disorders and supernatural abilities—trapped in an inescapable religious ritual.
You will uncover layers of lies and illusions to reveal the truth behind the Afflicted… or be consumed by deception.
[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]📌 [b]Add us to your Wishlist to stay updated on the latest news![/b][/h2][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3432860/_/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]💬 We also welcome you to join our Discord for discussions and updates:
👉 [url="https://discord.gg/8nnsMbzDQG"]https://discord.gg/8nnsMbzDQG[/url][/p][p][/p][p]We will continue to reveal more game content and character information in the coming months.
Thank you for your support—let's witness the birth of [i]PSYCHO-SLEUTH[/i] together![/p]
